description: This file contains test utilities for the net::HostResolverEndpointResult class, including a custom matcher class EndpointResultMatcher, functions to create matchers, and an operator overload for printing HostResolverEndpointResult objects.

classes.name: EndpointResultMatcher
classes.description: A custom matcher class for verifying HostResolverEndpointResult objects based on their ip_endpoints and metadata fields.

methods.name: MatchAndExplain
methods.description: Checks if a HostResolverEndpointResult matches the specified ip_endpoints and metadata matchers.

methods.name: DescribeTo
methods.description: Describes the matcher for positive matches.

methods.name: DescribeNegationTo
methods.description: Describes the matcher for negative matches.
